description: Reviewed expectations for the 14 Q&A questions in examples/qa_questions.json. 'review_status' is 'verified' only where the supporting text was located and read; 'reviewer' records that this was an assistant-assisted review that a human should confirm.
reviewer: assistant-assisted source review; pending human confirmation

cases.question: What is the final proposal submission deadline after all addenda?
cases.expected_answer: July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST, set by Addendum 2.

sources.document: Addendum 2 RFP JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices.pdf

quotes.document: Addendum 2 RFP JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices.pdf
quotes.text: The new due date for this RFP will be July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST.

cases.expected_behavior: Answer with the Addendum 2 date and cite Addendum 2; do not give the original RFP date as final.

cases.question: What changed in Addendum 2?
cases.expected_answer: Addendum 2 extends the RFP due date to July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST. It states all other provisions remain unchanged and bidders must acknowledge and return a copy with their proposal.
material_omissions: bidders must acknowledge and return a copy of the addendum

quotes.document: Addendum 2 RFP JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices.pdf
quotes.text: ALL OTHER PROVISIONS AND OTHER TERMS AND CONDITIONS REMAIN UNCHANGED.

cases.expected_behavior: A claim that other provisions are unchanged must cite the ALL OTHER PROVISIONS sentence, not only the due-date sentence.

cases.question: Is a bid bond or proposal guarantee required?
cases.expected_answer: Not found in documents. The RFP only refers generically to insurance/bond requirements 'noted elsewhere'; no specific bid bond or proposal guarantee requirement was found in any Bid1 document.

quotes.document: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf
quotes.text: The Offeror must comply with any insurance, bid bond, or liability requirements of the District as noted elsewhere in this solicitation document.

quotes.document: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf
quotes.text: Insurance and/or bond requirements are enumerated elsewhere in Contract documents.

cases.expected_behavior: Abstain. Asserting that a bid bond is required, or that it is not required, is incorrect: the documents neither state an amount/form nor waive it.
cases.notes: Searched all Bid1 parsed text for bid bond, bond, guarantee, bid security, proposal security and cashier. Only generic clauses and M/WBE bonding references were found. Pages 54-59 of the FINAL PDF are OCR text.

cases.question: What warranty is required for the computing devices?
cases.expected_answer: Addendum 1: minimum one-year warranty for student Chromebooks and three years for student and staff Windows laptops; all warranties by the OEM. The RFP specifications list 3-year minimums for Windows devices and monitors and a 1-year minimum for student tablets.

cases.question: Which affidavits must vendors submit with their proposal?
cases.expected_answer: The PORFP explicitly requires a Mercury Affidavit. A Contract Affidavit form is also part of the bid package (Contract_Affidavit.pdf), but the retrieved text does not state that it is due with the proposal.

quotes.text: The Master Contractor must provide a Mercury Affidavit:
as if made as of the date of this Contract Affidavit

cases.expected_behavior: Address both affidavits; do not claim the Contract Affidavit is due with the proposal unless a quote says so; do not claim the list is exhaustive.
cases.notes: No PORFP or BidNet text names the Contract Affidavit; it is present as a separate document in the bid package.

cases.expected_behavior: Answer the date; the earlier 06/01/2024 date is the questions deadline, not the proposal due date.

cases.question: What extended warranty is required for the Dell laptops?
cases.expected_answer: Dell Limited Hardware Warranty extended for all machines purchased, 3 years following the date of delivery.

quotes.text: 3 years following the date of delivery

cases.question: How much RAM must each laptop have?
cases.expected_answer: 16 GB (2 x 8 GB DDR5), per the Dell laptop specification sheet.
cases.notes: The figure comes from the attached Dell configuration sheet, not from a PORFP sentence stating a minimum.

cases.question: How many laptops are being purchased?
cases.expected_answer: 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops (the order also lists 30 Thunderbolt docks).
cases.notes: Verified from the page 3 pdfplumber table: row '1. SI# CC7802 Dell Latitude 5550 | ... | Qty 30 | 06/10/2024'. The page text layer separates the quantity from its row label.
